e.summary: 小额保险（普惠保险）行业网络：出版物、资源库、培训与最佳实践小组，另有旗舰研究《Landscape of Microinsurance》独立站点
e.summary_en: The microinsurance (inclusive insurance) network: publications, a resource library, training and best-practice groups, plus a separate site for its flagship "Landscape of Microinsurance" study
e.body:
**Microinsurance Network（小额保险网络）** 是**小额保险/普惠保险领域的国际行业网络**（成员包括保险人、再保人、中介、研究者与发展机构）。本条目与 [[a2ii]] 同属本轮**普惠保险**取向——实测池内 **Microinsurance Network 相关条目为 0**，而池内普惠/小额保险侧此前只有零星条目（如 [[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），**「行业网络 + 景观研究」这一形态缺位**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 24.3KB，导航实测含 **About our network／About inclusive insurance／Annual reports／Our work／Events／Best practice groups／Publications／Resources／Training／Landscape of Microinsurance／News／Newsletter／Sign in／Join us**，并有 **EN／ES／FR 三个语言版本**；**出版物页 `/publications`（12.8KB）**正文实测以 **「The Landscape of Microinsura…」** 开头，即**旗舰研究《小额保险景观》**居于首位；⭐ 该研究**另设独立站点 `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org`（实测 HTTP 200，但页面仅 2,258 字节，为前端应用外壳）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「普惠保险的行业网络与景观研究」这一形态**——池内普惠保险侧此前是**工具与合成数据**（[[openimis]] 开源保险管理系统、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），而**「这个领域谁在做、覆盖多少国家、市场规模多大」这一层此前没有来源**；**《Landscape of Microinsurance》**正是**行业公认的年度景观研究**（覆盖国家、产品数、保费规模、监管环境），对做**普惠保险/小额保险选题**的学生是**最直接的领域地图与引用来源**。**② 与监管侧条目互补**——普惠保险的另一半是**监管能力建设**（见同轮 [[a2ii]] 与 [[iais-icp]]），**行业网络给市场侧、监管倡议给规则侧**，两者合起来才是完整图景；**③ 与市场数据条目并列**——可与 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[philippines-insurance-commission]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[seddk]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]] 一起用于**新兴市场保险覆盖比较**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页导航、出版物页与独立景观研究站点的存在**，**但《Landscape》站点仅 2,258 字节（前端外壳）、出版物条目未逐条打开**，因此**不能确认该研究的最新版本、覆盖范围与获取条件**（**部分资源可能仅对会员开放**——导航中实测存在 **Sign in** 与 **members only** 的注册入口）；**②** 首页体积较小（24.3KB），**可能为前端应用**；**③** 本次**未核实该网络的成员构成与治理**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供数据下载或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（24.3KB）、`/publications`（12.8KB）、`landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org`（2,258 字节）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开出版物、未核实会员门槛**。
e.body_en:
**The Microinsurance Network** is **the international industry network in microinsurance and inclusive insurance** (its members include insurers, reinsurers, intermediaries, researchers and development agencies). With [[a2ii]], it belongs to this round’s **inclusive insurance** direction — a measured search found **zero Microinsurance Network-related entries**, while the corpus’s inclusive and microinsurance side held only scattered items (such as [[openimis]], [[bima-mcp]] and [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]), with **the "industry network plus landscape study" form missing**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is 24.3KB and its navigation shows **About our network / About inclusive insurance / Annual reports / Our work / Events / Best practice groups / Publications / Resources / Training / Landscape of Microinsurance / News / Newsletter / Sign in / Join us**, with **EN / ES / FR** versions; the **publications page `/publications` (12.8KB)** opens with **"The Landscape of Microinsura…"**, i.e. the **flagship Landscape of Microinsurance study** ranks first; ⭐ that study **has its own site, `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org` (measured HTTP 200, but only 2,258 bytes — a front-end shell)**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "inclusive-insurance network and landscape study" form** — the corpus’s inclusive-insurance side previously consisted of **tools and synthetic data** ([[openimis]] open-source insurance management, [[bima-mcp]], [[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]), while **"who works in this field, how many countries are covered, how large the market is" had no source**; **the Landscape of Microinsurance** is precisely **the sector’s recognised annual landscape study** (countries, products, premium volumes, regulatory environment), making it **the most direct field map and citation for students choosing an inclusive or microinsurance topic**. **② It complements the regulatory side** — the other half of inclusive insurance is **supervisory capacity building** (see [[a2ii]] this round and [[iais-icp]]): **the network covers the market side, the initiative the rule-making side**, and together they form the complete picture; **③ it sits alongside market data entries** — usable with [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[philippines-insurance-commission]], [[ira-kenya]], [[acaps-morocco]], [[seddk]] and [[mas-insurance-statistics]] for **emerging-market insurance coverage comparisons**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage navigation, the publications page and the existence of the separate landscape site**, **but the Landscape site measured only 2,258 bytes (a front-end shell) and publication entries were not opened one by one**, so **the study’s latest edition, coverage and access conditions cannot be confirmed** (**some resources may be members-only** — the navigation shows **Sign in** and a members-only registration entry); **②** the homepage is small (24.3KB) and **may be a front-end application**; **③** the **network’s membership and governance were not verified**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers data downloads or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (24.3KB), `/publications` (12.8KB) and `landscape.microinsurancenetwork.org` (2,258 bytes) were measured at HTTP 200; **no publication was opened and no membership threshold was verified**.
e.body_hk:
**Microinsurance Network（小額保險網絡）** 是**小額保險／普惠保險領域的國際行業網絡**。本條目與 [[a2ii]] 同屬本輪**普惠保險**取向——實測池內 **Microinsurance Network 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 24.3KB，導航實測含 **About our network／About inclusive insurance／Annual reports／Our work／Events／Best practice groups／Publications／Resources／Training／Landscape of Microinsurance／Sign in／Join us**，並有 **EN／ES／FR** 三語版本；**出版物頁（12.8KB）**正文以 **「The Landscape of Microinsura…」** 開頭；⭐ 該研究**另設獨立站點（HTTP 200，但僅 2,258 字節，前端外殼）**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「普惠保險的網絡與景觀研究」這一形態**——池內此前只有**工具與合成數據**（[[openimis]]、[[bima-mcp]]、[[africa-synth-insurance-datasets]]），而**「這個領域誰在做、覆蓋多少國家、市場多大」此前沒有來源**；**《Landscape of Microinsurance》**正是**行業公認的年度景觀研究**，是**最直接的領域地圖與引用來源**；**② 與監管側互補**（[[a2ii]]、[[iais-icp]]）——**行業網絡給市場側、監管倡議給規則側**；**③ 可與 [[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[ira-kenya]]、[[acaps-morocco]]、[[seddk]] 等並用於新興市場比較**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁導航、出版物頁與獨立站點的存在**，**但景觀研究站點僅 2,258 字節、出版物未逐條打開**，**故不能確認最新版本、覆蓋與獲取條件**（**部分資源可能僅會員可見**）；**②** 首頁體積小，**可能為前端應用**；**③ 未核實成員構成與治理**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供數據下載或精算工具。**核實說明**：三項 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開出版物、未核實會員門檻**。
